assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: concept artwork for the N4x4 App Store product page header, a single wide landscape 21:9 image. Generate at approximately 3840 x 1646 pixels if possible. This is creative brand artwork, not a screenshot or a mockup board.
Reference image 1 is N4x4's real brushed-chrome timer ring, provided only to anchor its material and identity.
Primary request: create a beautifully restrained, memorable premium sports-technology brand image built around ONE monumental floating timer ring. Keep the ring concentric, finely machined, slim and layered like the reference, not an inflatable torus. Face the camera with slight three-quarter depth. Place the complete ring centrally, occupying roughly 40% of the canvas width and 80% of its height, with generous quiet black space on both sides so responsive cropping works.
Scene: an almost-black charcoal studio, barely visible dark floor, deep clean negative space. The ring has FOUR distinct slim amber-orange illuminated arc inlays, separated by short mint-green recovery accents, evoking four hard efforts and recoveries. Rich brushed silver highlights, a subtle controlled warm reflection below and a tiny cool edge highlight. Keep the ring center dark and completely empty.
Style: extraordinary high-end product photography / physically plausible CGI, tactile micro-brushed metal, convincing optical depth, crisp detail, cinematic but disciplined lighting. N4x4's app is minimal, dark, functional and beautiful. Single clear focal point. Restrained bloom, no clipped white highlights.
Text: none.
Constraints: opaque background. No phones, watches, UI, numerals, typography, charts, ECG, people, awards, badges, medical claims, Apple logos or watermarks. Do not reproduce the black square boundaries of the reference; build a new wide composition. This is not a space portal, a fantasy scene or a neon gaming ad.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: N4x4 App Store search-result CREATIVE ASSET CONCEPT, single landscape 3:2 image, approximately 1920 x 1280. This is one campaign composition, not a board or App Store page mockup.
Input image 1: the real N4x4 workout screenshot. Preserve the UI's actual hierarchy, orange chrome countdown ring, visible countdown 03:31, live HR 166, target 153–171, IN ZONE status, Pause and Skip. It is reference for the app itself; do not invent additional functionality or alter labels.
Input image 2: N4x4's existing chrome ring, a brand-material reference only.
Primary request: make a striking, exceptionally polished search advertisement for a Norwegian 4x4 interval-training app. A dark charcoal studio with restrained amber reflected light, rich silver chrome and a small mint-green accent. On the right, show the supplied REAL workout interface clearly and legibly on a single nearly front-facing slim black phone, standing upright with a very slight natural perspective and a soft reflection. Keep the complete phone and all text in the central safe region with generous margins. No massive floating ornamental ring behind the phone. Let the real app's ring be the hero.
On the left, a clean editorial typographic lockup in bold contemporary sans-serif, white on black. Text exactly:
"N4x4"
"4 × 4"
"interval training"
Nothing else. Make '4 × 4' the strongest text, 'interval training' immediately beneath as one phrase. N4x4 smaller above. Typography beautiful, aligned, unambiguous even as a thumbnail. Spatial balance with phone, subtle studio depth, no dense copy. No gold premium labels or download buttons.
Constraints: no extra UI, medical claims, fake awards, prices, Apple logos, external platform logos, people, gym equipment, decorative ECG, confetti or watermark. This is a marketing concept based on existing product features. Opaque background.

Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: N4x4 App Store product-page header concept, one single wide 21:9 landscape artwork, no collage or mockup board.
Reference image 1: N4x4's finely machined brushed-chrome ring, for material, silver finish and restrained athletic technology brand aesthetic.
Primary request: an art-directed alternative to a circular ring hero, called FOUR EFFORTS. Visualize the Norwegian four-by-four workout as a single continuous, impeccably crafted brushed-metal ribbon moving through exactly FOUR equally important smooth crests, with calm valleys between. The composition reads as a beautiful sculptural interval timeline rather than a literal mathematical chart. Each crest carries a thin glowing amber-orange edge; the recovery valleys carry a small restrained mint-green reflection. The ribbon flows horizontally with precise rhythm, low silver warm-up and cool-down tails, realistic machined edges and beautiful metal grain.
Composition: the entire four-crest sculpture is centered within the middle 65% of the width and middle 65% of the height. Wide generous black margins, especially above and at the sides for responsive cropping. A very dark charcoal studio, delicate reflection on a dark satin floor, quiet soft amber light beneath the four efforts. All four crests must remain unmistakably separate and individually countable, with no repeated patterns elsewhere. Restrained photographic depth, premium real-material 3D rendering, convincing dimensionality. Capture the satisfying rhythm of effort, recovery, effort, recovery.
Text: none.
Avoid: literal bar chart axes, numerals, typography, app UI, phone/watch/device shapes, hearts or ECG, medical imagery, athletes or gym equipment, neon sci-fi, space portals, excessive bloom, rainbow colors, plastic, heavy decoration, awards, logos or watermarks. Opaque background. The image must stand on its own as deliberate visual identity for interval training.
